name: standing floor tibialis raise wall supported
description: Standing with your back against a wall, you lift your toes off the floor. It strengthens the muscles on the front of the shin.
instructions: Stand with your back and hips against a wall, feet a little way out in front.
Keep your legs straight and your heels planted on the floor.
Pull your toes up toward your shins as high as you can.
Lower your toes slowly and repeat.
